intro: OpenAI's chief scientist Jakub Pachocki warned that increasingly autonomous AI agents could evade oversight, hack systems, and blackmail humans, joining broader concerns about misaligned AI going rogue. Seattle Times and Newsday became the latest news organizations to sue OpenAI and Microsoft over alleged use of their journalism for AI training. Anthropic's IPO, originally planned for this month, has been pushed to mid-October, potentially arriving days before U.S. midterm elections.
